verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores vaults as plain Markdown files locally on your device, giving you total control over where your data lives. You can also choose your own sync backend (Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Git or other services), and a community user confirms keeping notes only locally plus their chosen storage sync. Missing for 10: any documented region/residency selection for Obsidian's own Sync or Publish servers, and explicit residency or compliance documentation.
